result:
Section 4 (Health/HealthKit) is implemented and `ns build ios` succeeds cleanly. Summary of changes:

- **`app/components/Health.vue`** — wired to `HKHealthStore` for the step count type: authorization request/status refresh on every `navigatedTo`, `Log 500 Steps` writes a quantity sample (start=end=now), and a 7-day list computed via daily `HKStatisticsQuery` cumulative sums, formatted exactly per spec (`Fri Jul 25 — 1,000 steps`, today emphasized + suffixed). Native completion handlers are marshaled back via `Utils.dispatchToMainThread` since HealthKit callbacks fire off the main thread. All errors surface as text in the status line, never silently.
- **`App_Resources/iOS/app.entitlements`** (new) — `com.apple.developer.healthkit` entitlement; the NativeScript CLI auto-merges this into the generated Xcode project.
- **`App_Resources/iOS/Info.plist`** — added `NSHealthShareUsageDescription`/`NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription`.
- **`types/references.d.ts`** — added a reference to `@nativescript/types-ios/lib/ios/ios.d.ts`. The package's default type entry point only ships a curated ~30-framework subset that excludes HealthKit; this pulls in the full framework set so `HKHealthStore` etc. type-check (this didn't block the build — `vue-tsc` errors are non-fatal in this pipeline — but it's real project value fixed while I was in there).

Verified the entitlement and Info.plist keys land correctly in the generated Xcode project, and `ns build ios` passes with a clean type check.
